prompt:
Goal: Create a square cyberpunk anime game cover illustration styled like a corrupted retro arcade/VHS screen for ロスト・セーブ, with a dramatic close-up character reaching toward the viewer and a dense pixel UI overlay.

Canvas: Square 1:1 composition, dark black background, neon cyan/blue/purple palette, glowing CRT border, scanlines, chromatic aberration, glitch artifacts, pixel dithering, slight fisheye perspective, high contrast cinematic lighting.

Main subject: A young androgynous anime character named ALOKU leans forward from the center, holding a retro handheld game console/controller toward the camera in the lower left foreground. The hand and device are closest and slightly motion-blurred, while the face is sharp. The character has messy shoulder-length mint green hair fading into electric blue tips, wet-looking strands, one eye partly hidden by bangs, a mischievous sharp-toothed grin, pale skin, small hoop/drop earrings, a black choker, layered dark streetwear, and a pendant necklace. Strong cyan rim light outlines the hair and shoulders.

Layout and UI elements: Add exactly 14 visible retro game interface elements: 1 top-left “▶ PLAY” label, 1 top-right score block reading “HI-SCORE 00012026”, 1 pixel alien icon on the upper left, 1 player status block reading “1UP ALOKU”, 1 small square grid icon, 1 small star/spark icon, 1 hearts life meter with two filled hearts and three empty hearts, 1 tiny version label “ALOKU ver 1.00”, 1 vertical right-side text reading “INSERT ME IN YOUR HEART♡”, 1 speech bubble near the right center containing Japanese text “まだ 終われない。”, 1 vertical stack of four small skull icons, 1 “CHAPTER_01” block, 1 bottom choice prompt with two buttons “YES” and “NO”, and 1 bottom-left rarity badge reading “RARE”.

Text content: The main title must be large glowing pixel text across the lower center reading ロスト・セーブ, with the English subtitle “LOST SAVE” directly underneath. Below it add “> PRESS START_”. In the bottom right include small Japanese flavor text: “データが見つかりません だってボクは ‘バグった主人公’だから。” Bottom left under the RARE badge add two small bullet labels: “MUSIC JACKET” and “PIXEL EMO”.

Visual style: Highly detailed anime key visual, glossy digital painting mixed with pixel art HUD, neon cyan typography, black and teal arcade interface, corrupted save-file aesthetic, emotional but playful bugged protagonist mood, dramatic depth of field, intense screen glow, tiny pixel noise, broken UI fragments, no clean modern UI.

Constraints: Preserve the exact count of the 14 UI elements listed above, keep all text legible and positioned like a game start screen, avoid adding extra characters, avoid realistic photography, avoid watermark or logo unrelated to the design.

promptZh:
目标：为 ロスト・セーブ 创作一张方形赛博朋克动漫游戏封面插图，风格模仿损坏的复古街机/VHS 屏幕，画面包含一个向观众伸手的戏剧性特写角色以及密集的像素 UI 叠加层。

画布：1:1 正方形构图，深黑色背景，霓虹青色/蓝色/紫色调，发光的 CRT 边框，扫描线，色差，故障伪影，像素抖动，轻微鱼眼透视，高对比度电影级光效。

主体：一位名叫 ALOKU 的中性风动漫角色从中心向前倾身，左下方前景处手持复古掌机/控制器伸向镜头。手部和设备距离最近且带有轻微动态模糊，面部清晰。角色留着凌乱的齐肩 薄荷绿渐变电光蓝发梢，发丝带有湿润感，刘海遮住部分眼睛，露出顽皮的尖牙笑容，皮肤苍白，佩戴小圆环/水滴耳环、黑色项圈、叠穿深色街头服饰及吊坠项链。强烈的青色轮廓光勾勒出头发和肩膀。

布局与 UI 元素：添加精确的 14 个可见复古游戏界面元素：1 个左上角“▶ PLAY”标签，1 个右上角显示“HI-SCORE 00012026”的分数块，1 个左上方的像素外星人图标，1 个显示“1UP ALOKU”的玩家状态块，1 个小方格网格图标，1 个小星星/火花图标，1 个包含两个实心心形和三个空心心形的生命值槽，1 个微小的版本标签“ALOKU ver 1.00”，1 个右侧垂直文字“INSERT ME IN YOUR HEART♡”，1 个右侧中心附近的对话气泡，内含日文“まだ 終われない。”，1 个垂直排列的四个小骷髅图标，1 个“CHAPTER_01”区块，1 个底部包含“YES”和“NO”两个按钮的选择提示，以及 1 个左下角显示“RARE”的稀有度徽章。

文字内容：主标题必须是横跨底部中心的大号发光像素文字，内容为 ロスト・セーブ，下方直接标注英文副标题“LOST SAVE”。在其下方添加“> PRESS START_”。右下角包含简短的日文点缀文字：“データが見つかりません だってボクは ‘バグった主人公’だから。” 左下角 RARE 徽章下方添加两个小型项目符号标签：“MUSIC JACKET” 和 “PIXEL EMO”。

视觉风格：高细节动漫主视觉图，光泽感数字绘画与像素艺术 HUD 结合，霓虹青色排版，黑色与青色调街机界面，损坏的存档文件美学，情感丰富且俏皮的故障主角氛围，戏剧性的景深，强烈的屏幕光晕，细微的像素噪点，破碎的 UI 片段，避免使用现代简洁 UI。

约束：保留上述 14 个 UI 元素的精确数量，确保所有文字清晰可辨并像游戏开始界面一样排列，避免添加额外角色，避免写实摄影，避免添加与设计无关的水印或 Logo。
